doc.brief: The interface that is used to implement print preview.
doc.md:
The interface that is used to implement print preview.

A `GtkPrintOperationPreview` object is passed to the
[`PrintOperation::preview`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintOperation#event:preview) signal by
[`PrintOperation`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintOperation).

end_preview.md:
Ends a preview.

This function must be called to finish a custom print preview.

is_selected.brief: Returns whether the given page is included in the set of pages that have been selected for printing.
is_selected.md:
Returns whether the given page is included in the set of pages that
have been selected for printing.

render_page.brief: Renders a page to the preview.
render_page.md:
Renders a page to the preview.

This is using the print context that was passed to the
[`PrintOperation::preview`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintOperation#event:preview) handler together
with `preview`.

A custom print preview should use this function to render
the currently selected page.

Note that this function requires a suitable cairo context to
be associated with the print context.

got-page-size.brief: Emitted once for each page that gets rendered to the preview.
got-page-size.md:
Emitted once for each page that gets rendered to the preview.

A handler for this signal should update the `context`
according to `page_setup` and set up a suitable cairo
context, using [`PrintContext.set_cairo_context()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintContext#method:set_cairo_context).

ready.brief: The ::ready signal gets emitted once per preview operation, before the first page is rendered.
ready.md:
The ::ready signal gets emitted once per preview operation,
before the first page is rendered.

A handler for this signal can be used for setup tasks.
